result.title: RefineSplat: Reconstruction-Guided Object-Centric Gaussian Splatting for Open-Vocabulary Querying
result.summary: Open-vocabulary 3D scene understanding aims to segment and retrieve arbitrary objects in 3D scenes using natural language queries. Most existing methods typically follow a splat-then-segment paradigm, where 3D Gaussian Splatting is first reconstructed and then augmented with labels or language features for subsequent segmentation. However, this pipeline often suffers from view inconsistency, ambiguous object boundaries, and weak object-level correspondence, especially in complex static and dynamic scenes. Building on our prior Segment-then-Splat framework, we present RefineSplat, a reconstruction-guided extension that retains its object-centric paradigm: it first tracks objects in 2D and then reconstructs each object with a dedicated set of 3D Gaussians, preserving explicit object-Gaussian correspondence for unified open-vocabulary segmentation and retrieval. To improve robustness, we further close the loop between 2D tracking and 3D reconstruction. Since off-the-shelf video trackers can produce unreliable masks that propagate errors into object reconstruction, we introduce a reconstruction-guided feedback mechanism that refines object tracking using rendered masks and multi-view consistency. Moreover, instead of assigning each object a single language embedding, we propose a viewpoint-aware embedding assignment strategy, where each object maintains multiple view-clustered embeddings to capture view-dependent semantic cues. We also introduce Blender-OVS, a synthetic benchmark of static and dynamic sequences with exact object meshes and point clouds, enabling direct evaluation of extracted geometry. Experiments on static and dynamic benchmarks show improved rendered-view segmentation and lower object-level Chamfer distances, with competitive scene reconstruction quality.

AI.brief_summary: 该文提出 RefineSplat：先在 2D 中跟踪物体，再用每个物体专属的一组 3D Gaussians 重建，保持显式物体-Gaussian 对应以支持开放词汇分割与检索；并用渲染掩码与多视角一致性反馈修正跟踪，同时为每个物体分配多个视角聚类的语言嵌入，另发布含精确网格的 Blender-OVS 合成基准。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「跟踪—重建闭环反馈」与按视角聚类多重语义嵌入的做法，可能为 LVR 中视觉证据的自洽性校验、状态迭代更新及视角/位置相关的 latent 相似度提供类比线索，但属 3D 场景重建领域，与 VLM 推理状态的直接联系需核查。
